notes.title: Soundtrack Release/Bundle for "Three Fairies' Hoppin' Flappin' Great Journey!"
notes.content:
The soundtrack for "Three Fairies' Hoppin' Flappin' Great Journey!" soundtrack has been released!
A bundle with the game has also been launched, so please be sure to listen to it!

Click here to go to the soundtrack page.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1744010/_Soundtrack/

notes.title: The "Touhou Mystia's Izakaya" Collaboration Update!
notes.content:
Starting from the November 24th update, we will be collaborating with[b] "Touhou Mystia's Izakaya"[/b], a Touhou derivative game created by 
二色幽紫蝶 and Re零同人社, in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045010/b9f4f79341366d320c8660f5e70dd5437c5b4bb4.png[/img]

In the main game, stalls of "Mystia's Izakaya" will be set up in various locations!

Find the ingredients she is looking for, and exchange them for various items!

[u]The following are the locations where she will appear.[/u]
School
Snowfield
Desert
Mines
Grave

In addition, the dotted three fairies also appear in the game "Touhou Mystia's Izakaya"! Please try to take orders from these three fairies!
Click here to visit the "Touhou Mystia's Izakaya".
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1584090/Touhou_Mystias_Izakaya/

notes.title: We got a lovely fanart from Makoto Hirasaka (比良坂真琴)!
notes.content:
We got a lovely fanart of us!
Makoto Hirasaka is a fabulous illustrator known for “東方三月精”. (Twitter: @hirasaka8)
Thank you again, Hirasaka sensei!
We never thought we could get fanart for this game, so we're very impressed!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045010/3c64a9f05c5856c965ad80faddbc89cfa35067f8.png[/img]

We appreciate for your playing our “Three Fairies' Hoppin' Flappin' Great Journey!”.

notes.title: Bug fix release
notes.content:
ver3.0.1
The following bugs were fixed.
・The power of some magics don't change depending on levels
・Weird BGM loop in the certain situations
・"friends" and "enemies" were partly exchanged in the tactics
・Corrected literal error

Thank you for playing the game "Three Fairies' Hoppin' Flappin' Great Journey!"!
